title: Workplan position 12 (PC lane): the partisan deletion + Ob-from-defender, both ruled and ungated
description:
TWO RULED ITEMS, executed together per workplans/2026-09-28-the-plan-one-order-mc-v18-retired.md position 12. Neither needed a fresh decision; both were already ruled and the PC-lane ED block just needed a fresh allocation to cite them (references/id_reservations.yaml PC next_free 58->59, allocated per the file's own protocol, HANDOFF_PC updated to drop the stale 'exhausted' framing).

(1) THE PARTISAN DELETION. Jordan, 2026-09-20, choosing between renaming and deleting the polearm to resolve its naming collision with the new `pursuit_axes` pole of the same name (ED-IN-0261): 'use partisan. we can just get rid of it as a polearms.' (recorded in HANDOFF_PC_history.md, since ED-IN-0261's own ledger text covers only the character-model ruling and not this aside). Deleted the weapon record (weapons.py:322-336, the JD-5 comment + the 15-line dict) and its element-edges row (weapons.py, the `_EDGES` dict). Re-pointed FIVE stale citations rather than deleting them (weapons.py:51 roster comment, 'three'->'two' composites; combat_systems.py:361, re-pointed the worst-armour-defeat citation to guandao (adef_cap 0.169, already independently cited two lines over at core.py -- reusing an ALREADY-MEASURED figure rather than fresh-measuring a spetum/ranseur number, safer than fabricating a new one); combat_systems.py:464 and weapon_physics.py:266, re-pointed the wing-lugs/low-pc worked examples to spetum, which shares the same physical property; core.py:541, same guandao re-point as combat_systems.py:361). workbench/balance.py's WEAPONS list lost the entry. THREE GOLDEN FILES updated by surgical per-key deletion (not full JSON re-serialize -- a first attempt with json.dump(indent=1) reformatted golden_element_parity.json wholesale (5,685 lines) by silently changing its indent width from the original 2; redone matching the source file's own indent/sort_keys/ensure_ascii/no-trailing-newline exactly, verified by a minimal diff): r3_identity_golden.json (weapons.partisan), golden_element_parity.json, golden_heft_percussion_snapshot.json. TWO TEST FILES lost their partisan row/list-entry: test_combat_lever_sign_safety.py's DEFAULT_SIGMA_PINS dict (asserted == set(WEAPONS)), test_combat_audit_pins.py's weapon parametrize list. workbench/data/combat_armour_reference.json: regenerating via `--update` in a clean re-check (see falsifier) showed the tool's own per-(weapon,armor) RNG seed is process-hash-seed-sensitive somewhere downstream of the seeded draw itself -- a fully unchanged tree, re-run in a fresh process, produced cells up to ~0.15 away from its own committed reference (still within the gate's 0.15 tolerance, which is evidently sized to absorb exactly this) -- so a blind `--update` after only deleting partisan would have committed dozens of cells' worth of pure process noise alongside the one real deletion. Fixed by a surgical single-key removal for the partisan-only pass (falsifier: added=[] removed=[] moved=[] against the pre-edit committed reference, confirmed by tests/valoria/test_combat_armour_reference.py). Two collateral test floors needed lowering (roster shrank 53->52 weapons): test_combat_edges.py's authored-edges element count 68->65 (partisan's 3 edges-authored elements); test_combat_audit_pins.py's cut_thrust versatile-head cell count 55->51 (partisan's 4 tier cells, all of which selected the versatile head).

(2) OB-FROM-DEFENDER. Jordan, 2026-08-15, verbatim (tests/valoria/test_degree_ladder_single_owner.py RULINGS dict): 'DECISIVE_OB for combat is stupid as hell and is dead because Ob should be determined by your opponent more than anything.' The SAME ruling has a settled, non-obvious order: derive Ob from the defender FIRST, THEN migrate the degree ladder itself -- doing the ladder migration first was already measured (ED-IN-0187) to break test_plate_participation_tracks_armour_defeat_capability (guandao 2.5%->47.5% against a since-abolished 40% ceiling). This build is ONLY the first half. Added core.ob_from_defender(defender) = defender.history/2.0 -- History is this resolver's own single score (the same one resolution_pool() derives dice from, ED-901); combat_engine_v1 has no separate 'capability' surface the way the season seam does. NO per-instance modifier is added: wound impairment already has its owner (combat_systems.wound_impairment, ED-1041) folded into net_sigma at every call site, and adding a second wound term onto Ob would double-count it -- the same class of defect wrapper.py's own C-2 comment already guards defence_sigma against. core.resolve() no longer takes a fixed Ob: `ob` is now a REQUIRED 4th argument (no silent DECISIVE_OB fallback), and all three wrapper.py call sites (the main exchange, the stop-thrust, the disengage-pursuit) now pass core.ob_from_defender(<the role actually struck if the roll lands>). DECISIVE_OB survives only as strike()'s unrelated severity-tail reference (an unruled, separate formula) -- nothing that decides a degree reads it any more. core.py's HELD-ladder docstring and test_degree_ladder_single_owner.py's RULINGS/HELD entries are corrected in place (not merely appended past) to say the Ob-derivation half landed while the ladder-migration half is still open and still, correctly, diverges from the owner -- the mechanical test that asserts the divergence is unaffected, since degree()'s own band-boundary formula is untouched.

THIS MOVES OUTCOMES BROADLY AND ON PURPOSE (a typical defender's derived Ob, ~1.5 at the default History=3, sits well below the old fixed 3, so fights decide faster across the whole roster) -- VERIFIED rather than assumed, per three re-measured falsifiers: test_combat_tradition_levers.py's per-fight-texture divergence rate roughly halved (katana/arming 12.5%->5.25%, dagger/arming 13%->7.75%, both at a re-measured n=400 for power; floor lowered 5%->2% with the same ~2.5x margin the prior re-baseline (ED-PC-0034) used); test_combat_draw_stream.py's heavy/none underlying-draw ratio at seed 4242 fell 2.95x->1.38x (a represent-gate property that still holds, just more weakly, since fights are shorter at every tier now -- floor lowered 2.0x->1.2x, comfortably below the new measurement, informed by a 10-seed spot-check showing this specific ratio is naturally noisy, 0.95x-3.1x, seed to seed); workbench/data/combat_armour_reference.json regenerated via `--update` a second time (this pass IS a real, ruled behaviour change, unlike the partisan-only pass above), verified green by the same committed-reference gate. Every other targeted PC-lane test file (see falsifier) held.

passed, 21 skipped -- the six-test drop is collected-parametrization shrinkage from the smaller roster, not a suppressed failure). engine/tests/test_pipeline_reach.py Two failures surfaced and were fixed rather than relaxed-without-measurement: test_combat_edges.py and test_combat_audit_pins.py's authored-roster floors (68->65, 55->51, both re-derived from the exact element/cell count partisan contributed, not guessed). Three more surfaced from Ob-from-defender specifically (test_combat_tradition_levers.py, test_combat_armour_reference.py, test_combat_draw_stream.py) and were re-measured and re-pinned with the new figures stated in this entry, not silently loosened.
provenance: MEASURED-BY: tests/valoria/test_combat_tradition_levers.py (the divergence-rate re-measurement is the test's own assertion, re-runnable as-is); tests/valoria/test_combat_draw_stream.py (the heavy/none draw-ratio re-measurement, likewise); systems/combat/combat_engine_v1/workbench/armour_participation.py --update (the committed reference regeneration). The armour-reference hash-seed-sensitivity finding was verified by running armour_participation.py's own `_duel` twice against an unmodified HEAD checked out into a throwaway `git worktree` -- once via `import workbench.armour_participation`, once via the canonical bare `import armour_participation` after a `sys.path` insert matching the tool's own CLI/test usage -- both giving a value 0.025-0.118 away from the committed reference despite zero code change; `armour_participation.drift(tolerance=0.15)` at that same unmodified HEAD reported zero moved cells, confirming the gate's tolerance already absorbs this and that a surgical single-key removal (rather than a blind regenerate) was the correct move for the partisan-only pass. Guandao's adef_cap/damage figures reused in the re-pointed comments are not re-measured here; they were already recorded, independently, at core.py's own neighbouring comment before this change.

title: Workplan position 12 (PC lane): the partisan deletion + Ob-from-defender, both ruled and ungated
description: CLOSING ROW — the three findings of the plan-Phase-1 terminal critique on this id, resolved at PC-03 (B-D1, commit 2a3ce24c). (1) `workbench/probabilities.py` bands each distribution at the defender's own Ob through `core.band_floor`, and the `roll`/`stophit` trace events carry `ob`; BUILT, with `tests/valoria/test_combat_ob_from_defender_consumers.py` red on the parent. (2) `strike()`'s overwhelming-hit tail `z` starts at the owner's bar for the defender's Ob, `band_floor('overwhelming', ob)`, and `DECISIVE_OB` is deleted: BUILT, not the entry's guess of `2*ob`, which is the pre-ruling ladder's bar (`degree_from_net`'s docstring rules it out). (3) History reaches the roll through more than one channel (Ob; `reading()`'s READ_HISTORY_K term, folded into `mode_sigma` for all three modes and the largest; `init_emphasis_sigma`'s INIT_HISTORY_K term; and, for parry and wind, `mode_sigma`'s `tech` term): RECORDED, not changed; pinned as a strict `xfail(raises=AssertionError)` so it cannot go stale; whether the double entry is intended is a design call. Declared hash mover: `build_realm(0)` one-season hash 8140da01 -> ef04434c.
falsifier: (1) `tests/valoria/test_combat_ob_from_defender_consumers.py`: the workbench's band probabilities for a History-5 defender against `core.resolve`'s observed frequencies over 20,000 seeds disagree far beyond noise on the parent tree (fail 0.209 against 0.513 observed at net_sigma -0.5) and agree after; the trace events carry `ob`. (2) the same file's overwhelming-quality test is red on the parent at History 2, 3, 5 and 8 and green after (History 6 is the natural control: its bar is 6 either way). (3) the strict `xfail(raises=AssertionError)` on `test_history_enters_the_roll_through_exactly_one_channel`: it XPASSes, and fails the suite, the day History is routed through one channel.
provenance: B-D1 PC-03 (commit 2a3ce24c), built and closed under workplans/valoria_master_workplan_v9_part7.md PC-03; the three findings are those of the plan-Phase-1 terminal critique recorded in the earlier ED-PC-0058 row and HANDOFF_PC.

title: PC-17 (B10-10b close six): 21 GENERIC calibration abilities on the seven levers; the `tempo` site as a log-edge
description:
PERMISSION, Jordan 2026-11-01, verbatim: "a spread of generics for now so that we have more calibration data". BUILT (workplans/valoria_master_workplan_v11_part4.md PC-17, items 1-6): (a) 21 abilities in modules/combat/ability_primitives.py ABILITIES, all op '*', grade 'GENERIC', values [SIM-CALIBRATE]: the seven levers visual, precommit, tactile, tempo, balance, edge_read, choke_control x three tiers; the six beneficial levers at x1.10 / x1.25 / x1.50 EXCEPT edge_read's refined tier, REVISED from the plan's x1.50 to x1.40 under the plan's own falsifier ('a generic with a cliff ... its tier is revised, not shipped'): edge_read subtracts from the aggressor's legibility, which has no lower bound, and at x1.50 level 8 a thrust by a double edge reads below 0 (spear, rapier -0.225; jian, whose ornament also subtracts, -0.316), after which the DEFENDER's visual and precommit factors scale a negative read and investing makes the defender worse (keen_eye_refined L0 -> L4 against a spear: p_read 0.0259 -> 0.0021). The level-8 root on the jian is x1.4325; x1.40 leaves legibility 0.119 there and 0.21 on a spear or rapier (basic 0.62, practiced 0.47 at level 8). STACKING: factors multiply and a fighter knowing japanese, chinese or filipino together equips several edge_read generics, so two (refined L8 plus practiced L1 on a jian thrust: 1.4^8 x 1.25 = 18.45 against the jian's root of 17.73) already drive legibility below 0, which no tier value can prevent while edge_read stays useful. The reviewers' ruling (the antagonist at BATCH-CLOSE): combat_systems.legibility is FLOORED at 0, byte-identical at default builds (the roster's minimum is 0.669 over every weapon x armour tier x commit 3 to 6 x lunge; 11,334 legibility calls in the fingerprint run have a minimum of 0.77); past the root the defender's read levers go inert instead of harmful. x1.40 is kept so that a SINGLE generic never reaches the floor (the single-generic probe asserts legibility > 0). choke_control as a MITIGATOR at x0.90 / x0.75 / x0.55 (its site adds to the opponent's legibility, so a factor below 1 helps its owner). Placement is a Latin square over the seven traditions in traditions.TRADITIONS order (german, italian, spanish, japanese, chinese, filipino, english): tradition t receives (lever (t+k) mod 7, tier k) for k = 0, 1, 2, so each (lever, tier) pair exists in exactly one tradition and each tradition gains three generics on three levers. Plain descriptive names, no period terms (ED-PC-0026). facing_regime stays bare (Jordan 2026-11-01: geometry, not this position). (b) combat_systems.init_emphasis_sigma no longer multiplies its signed base sum by eff_cw(aggressor,'tempo') (a factor above 1 amplified a NEGATIVE sum, the ED-PC-0045 defect); it is now the base sum plus CFG INIT_TEMPO_LEVER_K * lever_log_edge(eff_cw(aggressor,'tempo'), eff_cw(defender,'tempo')), exactly 0 at default builds. A STATED SEMANTICS CHANGE: the defender's tempo factor now enters, and a tempo generic is an additive monotone shift, not a scaling of the attribute terms. (c) per-site sign-safety probes in tests/valoria/test_combat_lever_sign_safety.py for every (lever, tier, site): 29 probes over 12 combat_systems functions x the three generics on each lever, each asserting the owner is behind where a signed differential exists, non-decreasing goodness over levels 0-8, and the tradition gate (ED-PC-0028); balance includes Agility 1 / Strength 1 owners (balance_eff 0). That path was dropped by ED-IN-0314's cull (2026-11-04, FORK:8047c6e0, a file with no unique kill); it is re-created holding only these probes, not the dropped file's. (d) systems/combat/combat_engine_v1/state_graph.py INJECTION_POINTS rewritten to the live call sites. REVERT: delete every ability with grade 'GENERIC' from ability_primitives.ABILITIES and their probes in test_combat_lever_sign_safety.py. The CFG key INIT_TEMPO_LEVER_K may STAY (with no 'tempo' ability the term is exactly 0.0): deleting the key alone raises KeyError in combat_systems.init_emphasis_sigma, so delete the key and that term together or not at all. Restoring init_emphasis_sigma's multiplicative form is NOT part of the revert (that form is the sign defect). The legibility floor is harmless to keep. (e) CALIBRATION (item 7). MEASURED-BY: systems/combat/combat_engine_v1/workbench/calibrate_generics.py (landed at close six, when the ED-PC-0040 gate refused measured numbers with no named instrument in the tree; the numbers were first produced by a scratch copy of it, and a standing driver had been weighed and declined as accretion; it composes on build_levers.build and is the caller the plan's CR-85 re-read, part4:793, needs: the calibration base names INIT_HISTORY_K, which CR-85 replaces). `--cell LEVER TIER LEVEL KIND N` re-derives one cell exactly (checked at tempo basic L2, seed 49685, against the recorded row) and `--analyze OUTFILE` reprints the controls, the table and the verdicts from a run's file; the full grid is about 12 minutes on 4 cores. Its seed recipe, zlib.crc32(repr((lever,name,float(level),kind)).encode()) % 100000, is its own, not build_levers._seed's (% 9999). n=10000 fights per cell, S as A and as B 5000 each, one random.Random(seed) per cell, seed=zlib.crc32(repr((lever,name,float(level),kind)).encode())%100000; every subject built tradition='none' with known_traditions=(teaching tradition,) and equipped={generic: level} through workbench/build_levers.py (balance._mk not used); opponent the same weapon and armour, plain. Effect = percentage points against the pooled level-0 rate, benefit positive; cluster-ratio Wilson per rate, Newcombe difference, 95%; the p_read and bind-dominance readings are analytic per-event probabilities, not Bernoulli outcomes (n_eff capped at the event count; balance counts damage points as events, which is anti-conservative). Measures: visual and precommit P(read) as defender; tactile P(dominate the bind); tempo initiative share; balance share of wound damage (PC-13 wound events); edge_read and choke_control the opponent's P(read) against S's attacks (lower is the benefit; choke_control on events with choke_counterbalance > 0). Weapon/armour: arming/light for visual, precommit, tempo; longsword/light for tactile, edge_read; arming/none for balance; poleaxe/light for choke_control. CONTROLS, all read before the table: three same-build level-0 replicates agree (|z| <= 1.8); the mirror (both sides equipped) sits inside its CI at L0, L4 and L8 for all seven levers (-0.74 to +0.41 pp); zeroing the lever's K nulls the L8 effect for tactile (BIND_TACTILE_K: +44.9 -> +0.06 pp), balance (FOOT_MEASURE_K and PURSUIT_FOOT_K: +44.3 -> -0.30), edge_read (LEGIB_EDGELINE_K: +26.6 -> -0.01), choke_control (CHOKE_ACCURACY_K: +1.49 -> +0.06), and visual and precommit (the LEGIB_* keys AND the module-level LEGIB_SWING_ROOM_K, which is not in CFG: a first run that zeroed only the CFG keys was not null, 0.065 -> 0.966, was caught by this control and fixed before any number was read). tempo: the K control DOES NOT ISOLATE THE NEW SITE. 'Initiative share' is the share of exchanges S initiates. INIT_TEMPO_LEVER_K alone does not null it at refined L8 (+50.1 pp), but that cell is pinned at the ceiling, where tempo_pressure (cs:1346-1348) alone already saturates it, so removing the new term can show nothing there; with READ_TEMPO_K also zeroed the share is +0.10 pp, a null that leaves counter_select, init_steal_factor and init_overcommit_loss live. The new term's DIRECT size is exactly 0.03 x 8 x ln 1.5 = 0.0973 sigma at refined L8; the 0.106 sigma measured on the mean attack net_sigma is a difference of means that includes knock-on movement (init_edge through initiative), not the site's own contribution. K = 0.03 is therefore uncalibrated, and the tempo rows would read the same at the pinned cells with the rewrite reverted; an isolating run (READ_TEMPO_K = 0, INIT_TEMPO_LEVER_K on versus off at unpinned cells, e.g. timing_refined L2 and L4) is NOT done. FROZEN OPPONENT: tempo_pressure is clamped at 0, so against timing_refined at level 6.45 and above (level 5.03 at an initiative difference of 0) the opponent's pressure is 0 at any initiative, its readiness never accrues and it acts only from its initial ready, a pursuit seize or a riposte; practiced L8 does it whenever S holds the Vor by more than 0.85. No tempo ability existed before PC-17, so this is newly reachable. Recorded as a SATURATION, not a cliff, under the same reading as visual and precommit (calibration data was the purpose of the generics, ED-PC-0059's permission); not revised here. Disclosed as an assumption: [ASSUMPTION; medium; Jordan to correct; revert: lower the timing_* tiers or bound tempo_pressure's floor]. Effect in pp at levels 1/2/4/8 (L8 95% CI):
visual keen_eye_basic (german) +6.2/+13.1/+28.1/+51.8 [51.4,52.3]; keen_eye_practiced (english) +15.6/+33.2/+55.7/+59.6 pins L8 [59.3,59.9]; keen_eye_refined (filipino) +30.0/+53.5/+59.6/+59.6 pins L4 [59.3,59.9]
precommit reading_intent_basic (italian) +6.2/+13.1/+28.1/+51.8 [51.4,52.3]; _practiced (german) +15.6/+33.2/+55.7/+59.6 pins L8; _refined (english) +30.0/+53.5/+59.6/+59.6 pins L4 [59.2,59.9]
tactile blade_feel_basic (spanish) +0.3/+0.5/+1.5/+3.8 [2.6,5.1]; _practiced (italian) +0.9/+1.6/+4.2/+14.4 [13.1,15.6]; _refined (german) +1.4/+3.9/+11.7/+44.9 [44.1,45.7]
tempo timing_basic (japanese) +0.8/+2.1/+5.1/+13.0 [12.5,13.4]; _practiced (spanish) +2.6/+6.4/+16.5/+46.6 [46.3,46.9]; _refined (italian) +5.4/+14.2/+41.6/+49.9 pins L8 [49.7,50.1]
balance footing_basic (chinese) +1.4/+3.1/+6.3/+15.6 [14.8,16.4]; _practiced (japanese) +3.7/+8.1/+19.0/+39.3 [38.7,39.8]; _refined (spanish) +6.8/+16.3/+36.9/+44.3 [43.8,44.7]
edge_read hidden_return_basic (filipino) +0.3/+0.6/+1.3/+3.1 [2.4,3.7]; _practiced (chinese) +0.7/+1.5/+3.9/+12.3 [11.7,12.9]; _refined (japanese, x1.40) +1.1/+2.6/+7.3/+26.6 [26.1,27.1]
choke_control quiet_gather_basic (english) +0.2/+0.3/+0.6/+0.9 [0.1,1.7]; _practiced (filipino) +0.4/+0.7/+1.1/+1.4 [0.6,2.2]; _refined (chinese) +0.7/+1.1/+1.4/+1.5 [0.7,2.3]
CONTROL LIMITS: the visual and precommit K-zero control is weak (zeroing the LEGIB_* constants sets legibility, hence read_d, to 0 whether or not the generic is wired); the mirror's floor (-0.74 to +0.41 pp) is as large as choke_control's whole effect (+0.2 to +1.5 pp) and as large as tactile and edge_read at L1 to L4, so choke_control basic at L1 to L4 sits inside the mirror noise; only the L8 CI is recorded per cell here. RESULT: all 21 are monotone within CI at levels 0/1/2/4/8, with no logit-step cliff and a detectable L8 effect, so none is revised on the plan's falsifier. FLAGS, not tier revisions: 'Cliff' is defined by neither the plan nor this row; the verdict below applies a logit-step test (a step above 2.5 times the step the overall slope predicts, at z > 2) with a rate pinned at 0.99 or more flagged 'pins', and a pinned cell passes 'monotone within CI' trivially (7 or more of the 21 generics). (i) visual and precommit SATURATE: refined reaches P(read) 0.9999 from L4 and practiced pins at L8, so the tier spread collapses above L4 (a ceiling, not a cliff); these two levers move the decisive win rate by only +1.5 to +2 pp at L8. (ii) With S's visual at refined L8 the OPPONENT's p_read against S's attacks falls from 0.404 to about 5e-33: visual has a very large attacker-side effect that this table does not measure. (iii) choke_control's ceiling (~1.5 pp) is set by CHOKE_ACCURACY_K x choke_counterbalance, not by the tier factors, so its tiers barely separate. (iv) timing_refined pins initiative share at L8 and timing_practiced and footing_refined reach 94 to 95 percent decisive wins at L8. NOT measured: other weapons, armours or attributes (one opponent and one weapon per lever); stacking of several generics on one fighter. Two cells (tempo timing_basic L2, seed 49685; choke_control quiet_gather_refined L8, seed 65482) were re-run from their seeds and matched exactly (tempo basic L2 again from the landed script): that shows determinism of the same driver, not corroboration of the measure. The visual and precommit rows agree to 0.1 pp at every level because both factors multiply read_d symmetrically in the measured defender role (cs:1135); their seeds, opponent-side and win-rate columns differ (visual alone has an attacker-side effect), so the rows are not aliased. COUNTER_SELECT CHECK (a review finding: the tempo counter_select probe asserts that the SELECTION FREQUENCY of a counter rises, not that the owner benefits, and a failed counter leaves the defender undefended; the WEAK build's counter success is about 0.233): measured at close six with build_levers.duel, a Cog 1 / Att 1 / History 1 / Agi 2 / Str 2 owner (tradition 'none', known_traditions japanese, spanish and italian) against the same stats unequipped, arming/light, n = 4000 position-swapped, decisive win% with Wilson 95% CI at tempo level 0/1/4/8: timing_basic 50.7/51.9/52.6/55.8; timing_practiced 50.2/49.3/57.7/70.5; timing_refined 49.3/51.8/67.8/95.0 (L8 CI 94.3 to 95.7).
